en:
## New Features

- TLS self-signed certificate generation: one-click RSA 2048 / 10-year cert, auto-enables HTTPS and restarts server
- Login page now shows localized error messages for invalid credentials, expired tokens, and missing users
- WebFetch tool supports AbortSignal for interruptible fetch operations

## Improvements

- Migrate browser engine from Playwright to Puppeteer for headless Chrome control
- Anthropic provider: three-layer empty message filtering prevents API errors from interrupted streams
- Anthropic provider: automatically append fallback text block for thinking-only assistant messages (fixes Xiaomi API compatibility)
- Browser session pages now inherit viewport (1280x900) and user-agent defaults
- Distinguish TOKEN_EXPIRED from UNAUTHORIZED in JWT authentication for clearer error responses

## Bug Fixes

- Fix `wait()` browser action not properly handling `attached` state (was treating it as `visible`)
- Fix `fill()` browser action using triple-click which fails in textareas; now uses Ctrl+A select-all
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- TLS 自签名证书生成：一键生成 RSA 2048 / 10 年有效期证书，自动启用 HTTPS 并重启服务器
- 登录页本地化错误提示：凭据错误、会话过期、用户不存在等场景显示中英文提示
- WebFetch 工具支持 AbortSignal 中断，叙述者可取消正在进行的网页抓取

## 改进

- 浏览器引擎从 Playwright 迁移到 Puppeteer，统一 headless Chrome 控制方案
- Anthropic 提供商三层空消息过滤，防止流式中断导致的 API 错误
- Anthropic 提供商自动为纯 thinking 消息补空 text 块，兼容小米等 API
- 浏览器会话页面继承默认 viewport（1280x900）和 user-agent
- JWT 认证区分 TOKEN_EXPIRED 和 UNAUTHORIZED，返回更精确的错误码

## 修复

- 修复浏览器 `wait()` 操作未正确处理 `attached` 状态（等价于 `visible`）
- 修复浏览器 `fill()` 操作使用 triple-click 在 textarea 中无法全选，改为 Ctrl+A
